doc: What a streaming reply shows of its text: the end is held back while it's half-finished markdown, so it never shows raw and then changes (spec, "A reply streams where it rests"). Both apps run these cases: the web's `settled` (apps/web/src/ui/Markdown.tsx, test/markdown.test.ts) and the Mac's `Markdown.settled` (FrogKit Markdown.swift, FrogTests/MarkdownTests). A finished message shows all of its text.

cases.why: plain prose shows as it arrives
cases.text: The retry waits on the store
cases.shown: The retry waits on the store

cases.why: an unclosed inline code span waits
a list item with words shows
inside an open fence the code shows as it arrives
only the last block is held: earlier ones are finished
code spans hide asterisks from the bold count
